ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

18. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

22. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Energy resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Sounds that alert us and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Harmful effects of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Meeting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
